Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next {{ rstackduration }} seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional {{ bonusdamage }} magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to {{ maxstacks }} times.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Voracity
abilities.description:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: Bouncing Blade
abilities.description: Katarina throws a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.
abilities.tooltip: Katarina throws a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor>, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to the target and {{ maxbounces }} nearby enemies. The <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Preparation
abilities.description: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a <font color='#FFF673'>Dagger</font> into the air directly above herself.
abilities.tooltip: Katarina tosses a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> into the air and gains <speed>{{ movespeedamount }}% Move Speed</speed> decaying over {{ movespeedduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shunpo
abilities.description: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.
abilities.tooltip:
Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for {{ totaldamage }} magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range.

Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ daggercooldownreduction }} seconds ({{ tooltipdaggerreduction }}). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Death Lotus
abilities.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and {{ addamagecalc }} physical damage, and applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for {{ grievousduration }} seconds.

Total over {{ duration }} seconds to each enemy: {{ totaldamagecalc }} magic damage and {{ totaladdamagecalc }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Divine Ascent
abilities.description: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

abilities.name: Radiant Blast
abilities.description: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.
abilities.tooltip: Kayle fires a celestial sword that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and removing <scaleArmor>{{ shredpercent }}% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for {{ shredduration }} seconds from the target and enemies behind them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Celestial Blessing
abilities.description: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.
abilities.tooltip: Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring <healing>{{ totalheal }} Health</healing> and granting <speed>{{ totalhaste }} Move Speed</speed> for {{ hasteduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Starfire Spellblade
abilities.description:
Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks.

Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional {{ epassivetotaldamage }} magic damage.

Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional {{ activetotalexecutedamage }} missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level {{ spell.kaylepassive:levelforpassiverank2 }}, causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Divine Judgment
abilities.description: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.
abilities.tooltip: Kayle makes an allied champion Invulnerable for {{ invulnduration }} seconds and then purifies the area around them, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Darkin Scythe
abilities.description:
Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin.

Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions.

Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Reaping Slash
abilities.description: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies.

Darkin Slayer: Instead deal {{ darkinflatdamage }} plus {{ darkinpercentdamage }} max Health physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blade's Reach
abilities.description: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.
abilities.tooltip:
Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by {{ e3 }}%, decaying over {{ e5 }} seconds.

Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range.

Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for {{ e2 }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Kayn can walk through terrain.
abilities.tooltip:
Kayn gains {{ e1 }}% Move Speed, becomes Ghosted, and can move through Terrain for {{ e2 }} seconds. When he first enters terrain, he restores {{ totalhealing }} Health.

Being Immobilized and spending more than {{ e3 }} consecutive seconds outside of Terrain ends this Ability early.

Shadow Assassin: Gain {{ e5 }}% Move Speed, Slow immunity, and reduce the Cooldown to {{ assassincdreduction }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Umbral Trespass
abilities.description: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Champions damaged by Kayn are marked for 3.15 seconds.

Kayn infests a marked enemy, becoming Untargetable. After {{ infestduration }} seconds or after Recasting, Kayn bursts out, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage to the enemy.

Shadow Assassin: Increases this Ability's range, the distance Kayn exits, and refreshes The Darkin Scythe's Cooldown on exit.

Darkin Slayer: Instead deals {{ slayerdamage }} max Health physical damage and restores {{ healvalue }} Health ({{ slayerhealpercent*100 }}% damage amount).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mark of the Storm
abilities.description: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

abilities.name: Thundering Shuriken
abilities.description: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.
abilities.tooltip: Kennen throws a shuriken, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to the first enemy hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Electrical Surge
abilities.description: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Every 5th Attack deals an additional {{ totaldamagepassive }} magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

Active: Kennen sends out a blast of electricity, dealing {{ totaldamageactive }} magic damage to nearby enemies affected by Mark of the Storm.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lightning Rush
abilities.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.
abilities.tooltip:
Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining {{ movementspeed*100 }}% Move Speed, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for {{ durationasball }} seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains {{ energyrefund }} Energy.

After this ability ends, Kennen gains {{ totalas*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ durationafterball }} seconds. Critical Strikes extend this duration by {{ critdurationbonus }} second(s). Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Slicing Maelstrom
abilities.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.
abilities.tooltip: Kennen unleashes a magical storm, dealing <magicDamage>{{ pertickdamagecalculated }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies every {{ kennenrtickrate }} seconds, and gaining <scaleArmor>{{ kennenrdefenses }} Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>{{ kennenrdefenses }} Magic Resist</scaleMR> for {{ kennenrduration }} seconds. Successive hits deal {{ damageamp*100 }}% increased damage for each hit the enemy has already suffered.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unseen Threat
abilities.description:
Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.

When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Taste Their Fear
abilities.description: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Reaper Claws</font>, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear.
abilities.tooltip: Kha'Zix slashes a nearby enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ spell.khazixq:basedamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. This deals <physicalDamage>{{ spell.khazixq:isodamage }} damage</physicalDamage> instead to enemies <keywordMajor>Isolated</keywordMajor> from their allies. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Spike
abilities.description: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Spike Racks</font>, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets are slowed for extra.
abilities.tooltip: Kha'Zix fires a spike dealing <physicalDamage>{{ basedamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit in a small area. If Kha'Zix is inside the area, he restores <healing>{{ healamount }} Health</healing>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.description: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Wings</font>, Leap's range increases and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.
abilities.tooltip: Kha'Zix leaps, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> upon landing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Assault
abilities.description: Each rank allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, giving it a unique additional effect. When activated, Kha'Zix becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font>, triggering Unseen Threat and increasing Move Speed. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Adaptive Cloaking</font>, Void Assault gains increased <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisibility</font> duration, and an additional use.
abilities.tooltip:
Active: Kha'Zix becomes Invisible for {{ stealthduration }} seconds and gains {{ bonusmovementspeedpercent*100 }}% Move Speed. Kha'zix may Recast this Ability once within {{ recastwindow }} seconds.

Passive: Leveling up this Ability allows Kha'zix to Evolve one of his Abilities, granting it additional effects.
  • Taste Their Fear: Gain Ability range, Attack range, and lowers Cooldown by {{ spell.khazixq:effect4amount }}% against Isolated targets.
  • Void Spike: Fires 3 spikes and Slows by {{ spell.khazixw:effect3amount }}%, increased against Isolated targets.
  • Leap: Increased range and refreshes Cooldown on champion takedown.
  • Void Assault: Invisibility duration lasts {{ evolvedstealthduration }} seconds and gains second Recast.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mark of the Kindred
abilities.description: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

abilities.name: Dance of Arrows
abilities.description: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.
abilities.tooltip:
Kindred vaults, firing an arrow at up to 3 enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and gaining {{ totalqattackspeed }} Attack Speed for {{ baseasduration }} seconds.

While inside of Wolf's Frenzy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to {{ cdnewvalue }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wolf's Frenzy
abilities.description: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him.  Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to {{ attackheal }} Health based on their missing Health.

Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal {{ basewolfdamage }} plus {{ percentwolfdamage }} current Health magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mounting Dread
abilities.description: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by {{ totalslow }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.

Kindred's third Attack against the target within {{ totalduration }} seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional {{ basebitedamage }} plus {{ percentbitedamage }} missing Health physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lamb's Respite
abilities.description: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.
abilities.tooltip:
Kindred blesses the ground for {{ buffduration }} seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone.

When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for {{ healflat }} Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
abilities.description:
Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts.

While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.

abilities.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
abilities.description:
Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled.

When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage.
abilities.tooltip:
Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit.

If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for {{ tetherpoptime }} seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing {{ totalyankdamage }} physical damage, Pulling them, and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Violent Tendencies
abilities.description: Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Kled's next Attack grants {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for four Attacks or {{ activeduration }} seconds.

The fourth hit deals an additional {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ percentdamage }} max Health physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Jousting
abilities.description: Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Kled dashes, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to enemies he passes through, pulling minions and small monsters towards him.

If this Ability hits an enemy champion or large jungle monster, Kled gains {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} second(s) and can Recast within {{ recastwindow }} seconds to dash back through the same target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
abilities.description: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.
abilities.tooltip: Kled charges toward an area, leaving a trail that grants allies increasing <speed>Move Speed</speed>. While charging and for 2 seconds after Kled gains up to <shield>{{ maximumshield }} Shield</shield>. Skaarl rams the first enemy champion encountered, dealing <magicDamage>{{ minimumdamagetooltip }}</magicDamage> to <magicDamage>{{ maximumchargedamage }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> (based on distance travelled) and briefly <status>Knocking Back</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Icathian Surprise
abilities.description: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Caustic Spittle
abilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Kog'Maw gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds {{ shredamount }}% Armor and Magic Resist for {{ shredduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
abilities.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>.
abilities.tooltip: Kog'Maw gains {{ range }} Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>{{ totalhealthdamage }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Ooze
abilities.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
abilities.tooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and leaving a trail of ooze for {{ trailduration }} seconds. Enemies in the ooze are <status>Slowed</status> by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Living Artillery
abilities.description: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.
abilities.tooltip:
Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing {{ basedamagecalc }} plus {{ tooltipmissinghealthdamageamp }}% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take {{ maxdamagecalc }} magic damage.

Subsequent shots within {{ manacostduration }} seconds cost an additional {{ basecost }} Mana (max: {{ manacostcap }} Mana).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dauntless Instinct
abilities.description:
K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack.

When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.

abilities.name: Ntofo Strikes
abilities.description:
K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line.

On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced.
abilities.tooltip:
K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage and Slowing enemies by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for {{ recastwindow }} seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for {{ stunduration }} second.

All Out: Cooldown is reduced by {{ rcooldownreduction.0*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Path Maker
abilities.description:
K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.

When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
abilities.tooltip:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for {{ mindurationtooltip }}-{{ maxduration.1 }}s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by {{ damagereduction*100 }}%. Then, he rams forward, dealing {{ basedamage }} + {{ totalmaxhealthdamage }} max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for {{ minknockbackduration }}-{{ maxknockbackduration }}s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional {{ rdamageincreasemin*100 }}-{{ rdamageincreasemax*100 }}% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to {{ rdamagereduction*100 }}% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Footwork
abilities.description:
K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.
abilities.tooltip:
K'Sante dashes, gaining {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded.

All Out: Cooldown is decreased by {{ cooldownmodao*100 }}% and dash speed is increased.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: All Out
abilities.description: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
abilities.tooltip:
K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing {{ basedamage }} physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for {{ alloutduration }}s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for {{ totaldamageslamdown }} physical damage.

While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed, {{ armorpenpercent*100 }}% Bonus Armor Penetration, and {{ omnivamp*100 }}% Omnivamp, but loses {{ healthlost*100 }}% max Health, {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Armor, and {{ defenseslost*100 }}% Bonus Magic Resistance.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mirror Image
abilities.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Sigil of Malice
abilities.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.
abilities.tooltip:
LeBlanc projects a sigil to an enemy, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and marking them for {{ markduration }} seconds.

Damaging the marked enemy with an Ability detonates the sigil, dealing {{ markdamage }} magic damage.

If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds {{ manarefund*100 }}% of the Mana cost and {{ cooldownrefund*100 }}% of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

The initial sigil deals an additional {{ bonusminiondamage }} damage to minions. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Distortion
abilities.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.
abilities.tooltip:
LeBlanc dashes then deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies. For {{ snapbacktimeallowed }} seconds after dashing, LeBlanc can Recast.

Recast: LeBlanc returns to her starting location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ethereal Chains
abilities.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.
abilities.tooltip:
LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage and granting True Sight.

If they remain shackled for {{ tetherduration }} seconds, LeBlanc Roots them for {{ rootduration }} seconds and deals an additional {{ delayeddamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mimic
abilities.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.
abilities.tooltip:
LeBlanc mimics her most recent Ability, using it again. The mimicked Ability deals increased damage.

Mimicked Sigil of Malice deals {{ rq1damage }} magic damage when applied, and {{ rq2damage }} magic damage when consumed.
Mimicked Distortion deals {{ rwdamage }} magic damage.
Mimicked Ethereal Chains deals {{ re1damage }} magic damage when shackled and {{ re2damage }} magic damage when Rooting.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

abilities.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
abilities.description:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.
abilities.tooltip:
Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing {{ initialdamage }} physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next {{ reactivatetime }} seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by the sound wave, dealing between {{ recastdamage }} to {{ empowereddamage }} physical damage scaling with the target's missing Health. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
abilities.description:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.
Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.
abilities.tooltip:
Lee Sin dashes to an ally or ward. If the target is a champion, Lee Sin grants them and himself {{ shieldamount }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Lee Sin may Recast for the next {{ w1reactivatetime }} seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin gains {{ lifestealandspellvamp }}% Omnivamp for {{ lifestealandspellvamptime }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tempest / Cripple
abilities.description:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.
abilities.tooltip:
Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals {{ initialdamage }} magic damage and reveals them for {{ slowduration }} seconds. If this hits an enemy, Lee Sin can Recast for the next {{ reactivatetime }} seconds.

Recast: Lee Sin Slows nearby enemies struck by the shockwave by {{ slowamount }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dragon's Rage
abilities.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.
abilities.tooltip:
Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing {{ damage }} physical damage.

Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take {{ damage }} plus {{ percenthpcarrythrough }}% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Sunlight
abilities.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

abilities.name: Shield of Daybreak
abilities.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
abilities.tooltip: Leona's next Attack <status>Stuns</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and deals an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }}</magicDamage> magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
abilities.tooltip:
Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by {{ flatdamagereduction }} and gaining {{ bonusarmortooltip }} Armor and {{ bonusmrtooltip }} Magic Resist for {{ armormrduration }} seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional {{ armormrduration }} seconds.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Zenith Blade
abilities.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.
abilities.tooltip: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The last champion struck will be <status>Rooted</status> for {{ rootduration }} seconds and Leona will dash to them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Solar Flare
abilities.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.
abilities.tooltip: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing <magicDamage>{{ explosioncalculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are <status>Stunned</status> instead of <status>Slowed</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dream-Laden Bough
abilities.description: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

abilities.name: Blooming Blows
abilities.description: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Lillia's Ability hits grant {{ prancespeed }} Move Speed for {{ pranceduration }} seconds, stacking up to {{ prancemaxstacks }} times.

Active: Lillia whirls her censer, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage, plus an additional {{ bonustruedamage }} true damage at the outer edge.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Watch Out! Eep!
abilities.description: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.
abilities.tooltip: Lillia winds up a huge strike, dealing <magicDamage>{{ flatdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies in the center take <magicDamage>{{ flatdamagesweetspot }} damage</magicDamage> instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Swirlseed
abilities.description: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.
abilities.tooltip: Lillia lobs a swirlseed overhead, dealing <magicDamage>{{ impactdamagetotal }} magic damage</magicDamage> where it lands and revealing and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lilting Lullaby
abilities.description: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.
abilities.tooltip:
Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for {{ drowsyduration }} seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for {{ sleepduration }} seconds.

When awakened by damage, they take an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Iceborn Subjugation
abilities.description: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

abilities.name: Ice Shard
abilities.description: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.
abilities.tooltip: Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowpercentage*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ring of Frost
abilities.description: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.
abilities.tooltip: Lissandra creates an ice field, <status>Rooting</status> nearby enemies for {{ snareduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Glacial Path
abilities.description: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.
abilities.tooltip: Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Lissandra can <recast>Recast</recast> while the claw travels to teleport to its location.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Frozen Tomb
abilities.description: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.
abilities.tooltip:
Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for {{ enemycastduration }} seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for {{ selfcastduration }} seconds and restores {{ healamount }} Health, increased by {{ selfcastmissinghpratio }}% for each {{ selfcastmissinghpperabove }}% missing Health.

In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing {{ calculateddamage }} magic damage. The ice persists for {{ slowduration }} seconds, Slowing enemies by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Silver Stake
abilities.description: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.

abilities.name: Ritual Nails
abilities.description: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.
abilities.tooltip:
Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing {{ missiledamage }} magic damage and marking enemies hit. Nails apply a {{ slowamount1*100 }}/{{ slowamount2*100 }}/{{ slowamount3*100 }}% Slow for {{ slowduration1 }}/{{ slowduration2 }}/{{ slowduration3 }} seconds, stacking with the amount of nails hit.

Attacking the enemy consumes the Soul Nails, dealing {{ naildamage }} magic damage per stack, increased by {{ twomarkbonuspercent }}% and {{ threemarkbonuspercent }}% for two and three nails respectively.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Soul Ignition
abilities.description: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.
abilities.tooltip:
Locke ignites his own soul, gaining {{ attackspeed }} Attack Speed and {{ movespeed }} Move Speed that decays over {{ decaytimehelper }} seconds.

For {{ baseduration }} seconds, he suffers {{ healthcost*100 }}% current Health true damage per second but Heals back the last {{ damagerestoreamount }} damage taken, and an additional {{ additionalheal }} Health based on missing Health and time passed, up to a maximum of {{ maxhealingthreshold }} Health remaining.

Can be Recast to end early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ashen Pursuit
abilities.description: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.
abilities.tooltip:
Locke teleports to a location, dealing {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival.

On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing {{ dashdamage }} magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails.

If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Purgatory
abilities.description: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip:
Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for {{ duration }} seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below {{ executetooltipcalc }}, and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions.

After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. Locke can pick up the artifact to permanently increase its execution threshold by {{ executethresholdperstack*100 }}%, and refund {{ cooldownreduction }}% of his total Cooldown, for each champion sealed.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lightslinger
abilities.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Piercing Light
abilities.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
abilities.tooltip:
Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ardent Blaze
abilities.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Lucian fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage, briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds.

When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains {{ movespeedamount }} Move Speed for 1 second. Allies triggering this effect will also grant Lucian Vigilance.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
abilities.tooltip:
Lucian dashes.

Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundbase }} second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger ({{ cdrefundchampion }} seconds for champions). {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Culling
abilities.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.
abilities.tooltip:
Lucian rapidly fires {{ totalnumshots }} shots in a direction for {{ duration }} seconds or until he Recasts. Each shot deals {{ damageperbullet }} physical damage to the first enemy hit.

While firing, Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit.

Total Damage: {{ totaldamage }} physical damage
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
abilities.description: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

abilities.name: Glitterlance
abilities.description: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
abilities.tooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*-100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Enemies take {{ bonusmissiledamage }} magic damage from additional bolts.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Whimsy
abilities.description: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
abilities.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Lulu grants {{ totalms }} Move Speed and {{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ msduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for {{ ccduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Help, Pix!
abilities.description: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
abilities.tooltip:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for {{ pixonallyduration }} seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and granting True Sight of them for {{ pixonenemyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.description: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Lulu enlarges an ally, <status>Knocking Up</status> surrounding enemies for {{ knockbackduration }} second. The enlarged ally gains <healing>{{ totalbonushealth }} max Health</healing> and <status>Slows</status> surrounding enemies by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Illumination
abilities.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

abilities.name: Light Binding
abilities.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.
abilities.tooltip: Lux fires a ball of light, <status>Rooting</status> the first two enemies for {{ rootduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }} magic damage</magicDamage> to each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Prismatic Barrier
abilities.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.
abilities.tooltip: Lux throws her wand, granting <shield>{{ totalshieldtt }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds to allies it passes through. Then it returns, granting the same <shield>Shield</shield> on its return.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Lucent Singularity
abilities.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.
abilities.tooltip: Lux creates a light zone that <status>Slows</status> by {{ slowpercent }}% and reveals the area. After {{ slowzoneduration }} seconds or on <recast>Recasting</recast> this Ability, it detonates, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> for an additional {{ slowlingerduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Final Spark
abilities.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.
abilities.tooltip: Lux fires a dazzling ray of light, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all enemies in a line.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Granite Shield
abilities.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

abilities.name: Seismic Shard
abilities.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>{{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ speedsteal }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Malphite also steals the amount <status>Slowed</status>, gaining it as <speed>Move Speed</speed> for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Malphite gains {{ bonusarmorpassive*100 }}% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f1 }}). This effect is increased to {{ bonusarmorpassive*300 }}% (%i:scaleArmor%{{ f2 }}) while Granite Shield is active.

Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional {{ totalbonusdamage }} physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals {{ thunderclapsplash }} physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next {{ thunderclapbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing <magicDamage>{{ edamagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> and reducing <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by {{ asreduction }}%</attackSpeed> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
abilities.tooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite <status>Knocks Up</status> for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Shift
abilities.description: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

abilities.name: Call of the Void
abilities.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip: Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Silencing</status> for {{ silenceduration }} second(s).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Swarm
abilities.description: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max {{ stackcap }}).

Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last {{ voidlingduration }} seconds and deal {{ voidlingbonusdamagetooltip }} magic damage each hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Malefic Visions
abilities.description:
Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.

If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.
abilities.tooltip:
Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ duration }} seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions.

If the victim dies, Malzahar gains {{ manarestore }} Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy.

Malefic Visions executes minions below {{ minionexecutethreshold }} Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Nether Grasp
abilities.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.
abilities.tooltip: Malzahar <status>Suppresses</status> an enemy champion and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ ccduration }} seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing <magicDamage>{{ zonedamagetooltip }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ poolduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Sap Magic
abilities.description: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

abilities.name: Bramble Smash
abilities.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.
abilities.tooltip: Maokai smashes his fist into the ground, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} plus {{ basepercenthealth*100 }}% max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and briefly <status>Slowing</status>. Nearby enemies are also <status>Knocked Back</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Twisted Advance
abilities.description: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.
abilities.tooltip: Maokai transforms into a moving mass of roots, becoming Untargetable and dashing to an enemy. Upon arrival, he <status>Roots</status> the enemy for {{ rootduration }} second(s) and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Sapling Toss
abilities.description: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.
abilities.tooltip:
Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for {{ saplingduration }} seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster.

If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for {{ empoweredsaplingduration }} seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing {{ totalempowereddamage }} magic damage over {{ empowereddotduration }} seconds and Slowing enemies by {{ empoweredslowamount }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.description: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.
abilities.tooltip: Maokai summons a colossal wave of brambles and thorns, <status>Rooting</status> enemies for {{ minrootduration }} to {{ maxrootduration }} seconds, increasing with distance travelled, and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Hitting a champion gives Maokai <speed>{{ movehaste*100 }}% Move Speed</speed>, decaying over {{ hasteduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Double Strike
abilities.description: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.

abilities.name: Alpha Strike
abilities.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
abilities.tooltip:
Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to all enemies hit after {{ alphastrikebounces }} hits.

This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing {{ subsequenthitmultiplier*100 }}% damage for subsequent hits ({{ subesquentdamage }}), for a maximum single target total of {{ singletotaldamage }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Meditate
abilities.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.
abilities.tooltip:
Master Yi channels, restoring {{ totalheal }} Health over {{ healduration }} seconds. This healing is increased by up to {{ maxmissinghealthpercent*100 }}% based on Master Yi's missing Health.

While channeling and for {{ drlinger }} seconds afterwards, he takes {{ initialdr }} reduced damage, decreased to {{ damagereduction*100 }}% after the first {{ initialextradrduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wuju Style
abilities.description: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.
abilities.tooltip: Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional <trueDamage>{{ totaldamage }} true damage</trueDamage> for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Highlander
abilities.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by {{ rcooldownrefund*100 }}%.

Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining {{ rmsbonus }}% Move Speed, {{ rasbonus }}% Attack Speed, and immunity to Slows for {{ rduration }} seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by {{ rkillassistextension }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Searing Brilliance
abilities.description:
Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.

When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

abilities.name: Radiant Barrage
abilities.description: Mel unleashes a volley of projectiles that deal magic damage. Hitting an enemy champion reduces this ability's cooldown.
abilities.tooltip:
Mel unleashes a barrage of {{ count }} missiles that explode at the target location. The first time an enemy is struck, they take {{ initialdamage }} magic damage, with subsequent hits dealing {{ subsequentdamage }} magic damage each, for a maximum of {{ totaldamagett }} magic damage.

If the volley hits an enemy champion at least once, this ability's cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundchamphit }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Rebuttal
abilities.description:
Mel unleashes a refraction nova that destroys enemy projectiles it collides with, retaliating with magic missiles.

The nova also shields and grants move speed to Mel and her allies.
abilities.tooltip:
Mel unleashes a refraction nova that destroys enemy projectiles it collides with, retaliating for {{ initialdamage }} magic damage. Subsequent retaliations against the same enemy deal {{ subsequentdamage }} magic damage instead.

The nova also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield and {{ totalms }} Move Speed for {{ buffduration }} seconds to Mel and her allies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Solar Snare
abilities.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.
abilities.tooltip:
Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for {{ rootdurationmin }} to {{ rootdurationmax }} seconds (based on distance travelled) and dealing {{ damage }} magic damage.

The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by {{ areaslowamount*100 }}% and deals {{ areadamagepersecond }} magic damage per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Golden Eclipse
abilities.description:
Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.

Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to {{ passiveflatdamage }} magic damage plus {{ passivestackdamage }} magic damage per stack.

Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing {{ ultflatdamage }} magic damage plus {{ ultstackdamage }} magic damage per Overwhelm stack.

Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fired Up!
abilities.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

abilities.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
abilities.description: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
abilities.tooltip:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowamountpercent }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds {{ refundratio*100 }}% of it's Mana cost.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Cozy Campfire
abilities.description: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.
abilities.tooltip:
Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Ally champions nearby gain {{ rangepercent }} Attack Range and restore {{ healingovertime }} Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every {{ healfrequencyseconds }} seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Warm Hugs
abilities.description: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.
abilities.tooltip:
Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting {{ shieldcalc }} Shield and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ movespeedduration }} seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Breath of Life
abilities.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
abilities.tooltip: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects, restoring <healing>{{ healcalc }} Health</healing>, and granting {{ tenacityamount*100 }}% Tenacity for {{ tenacityduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Love Tap
abilities.description: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

abilities.name: Double Up
abilities.description: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.
abilities.tooltip:
Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing {{ totaldamagetooltip }} physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them.

The second shot can critically strike for {{ totaldamagecrit }} physical damage. It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Strut
abilities.description: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: After {{ passivebasemsooc }} seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains {{ passivebasems }} Move Speed. After another {{ passivemaxmsextraooc }} seconds, this increases to {{ passivemaxms }}.

Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and {{ activeas*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ activeduration }} seconds.

Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by {{ lovetaprefund }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Make It Rain
abilities.description: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
abilities.tooltip: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, <status>Slowing</status> by {{ totalslowamount }} and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagepersecond }} magic damage</magicDamage> per second for {{ baseduration }} seconds (total <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bullet Time
abilities.description: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike
abilities.tooltip:
Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing {{ basewaves }} waves over {{ basechannelduration }} seconds, dealing {{ physicaldamageperwave }} physical damage per wave (total {{ totalphysicaldamage }} physical damage).

Each wave can critically strike for %i:scaleCrit% {{ critdamageperwave }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Stone Skin
abilities.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.
abilities.tooltip:
Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains {{ attackrangebonus }} range, deals an additional {{ bonusdamagett }} physical damage, and removes {{ armorshredpercent*100 }}% Armor for {{ shredduration }} seconds.

This Ability's cooldown is reduced by {{ cooldowndecrease }} seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Warrior Trickster
abilities.description: Wukong becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for {{ stealthduration }} second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for {{ cloneduration }} seconds.

The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing {{ clonedamagemod*100 }}% of normal damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Nimbus Strike
abilities.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.
abilities.tooltip:
Wukong dashes to an enemy, sending out Clones that mimic the dash to up to {{ extratargets }} additional enemies nearby. Each enemy struck takes {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. He and his Clone gain {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds.

{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.description:
Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.

Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.
abilities.tooltip:
Wukong gains {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for {{ knockupduration }} seconds and take {{ totaldamagett }} plus {{ percenthpdamagett }} max Health physical damage over {{ spinduration }} seconds.

This Ability can be cast a second time within {{ recastwindow }} seconds before going on cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Darkness Rise
abilities.description: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

abilities.name: Obliterate
abilities.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.
abilities.tooltip: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing <magicDamage>{{ qdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, increased to <magicDamage>{{ empowereddamagetooltip }}</magicDamage> if it hits only a single enemy.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Indestructible
abilities.description: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Mordekaiser stores {{ damageconversion*100 }}% of the damage he deals and {{ damagetakenconversion*100 }}% of the damage he takes.

Active: Mordekaiser gains the stored damage as Shield. He may Recast this Ability to restore {{ healingpercent*100 }}% of the remaining Shield as Health.

Minimum Shield: {{ minhealthtooltip }}
Maximum Shield: {{ maxhealthtooltip }}{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Death's Grasp
abilities.description: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Mordekaiser gains {{ magicpen*100 }}% Magic Penetration.

Active: Pulls enemies in his direction, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Realm of Death
abilities.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.
abilities.tooltip:
Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for {{ spiritrealmduration }}s, stealing {{ statstealpercentscalar*100 }}% of their core stats for the duration.

If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Soul Siphon
abilities.description: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

abilities.name: Dark Binding
abilities.description: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.
abilities.tooltip: Morgana hurls a blast of starfire that <status>Roots</status> the first enemy hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds and deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tormented Shadow
abilities.description: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.
abilities.tooltip:
Morgana ignites the ground for {{ wduration }} seconds, dealing {{ totalmindamage }} magic damage per second, increased by up to {{ totalmaxdamage }} based on the targets' missing Health.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundpercent*100 }}% every time Morgana is healed by Soul Siphon.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Black Shield
abilities.description: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.
abilities.tooltip: Morgana grants an ally champion <shield>{{ totalshieldstrength }} Magic Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. The shield prevents <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects until it breaks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Soul Shackles
abilities.description: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.
abilities.tooltip:
Morgana chains herself to nearby enemy Champions, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing them by {{ slowpercent }}%. After {{ chainduration }} seconds, enemies unable to break the chains take an additional {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and are Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds.

While casting this Ability, Morgana gains {{ hastepercent }}% Move Speed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

champions.name: Naafiri
champions.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites

abilities.name: We Are More
abilities.description: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.

abilities.name: Darkin Daggers
abilities.description:
Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.

Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.
abilities.tooltip:
Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totaldamagefirstcast }} physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing {{ spell.naafiriq:totalbleeddamage }} physical damage over {{ spell.naafiriq:bleedduration }} seconds.

Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmindamagesecondcast }} and {{ spell.naafiriq:totalmaxdamagesecondcast }} physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores {{ spell.naafiriq:totalhealsecondcast }} Health.

Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for {{ spell.naafirip:packmatetauntduration }} seconds.

{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Call of the Pack
abilities.description: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Naafiri becomes Untargetable for {{ untargetableduration }} second and prepares to hunt, spawning {{ packmatestoadd }} additional Packmates and gaining {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ duration }} seconds.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.description: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.
abilities.tooltip:
Naafiri surges forward, dealing {{ totaldamagefirstslash }} physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing {{ totaldamagesecondslash }} physical damage.

Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hounds' Pursuit
abilities.description: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.
abilities.tooltip:
Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing {{ packmatedamage }} physical damage per Packmate.

If Naafiri scores a Takedown within {{ takedownwindow }} seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants {{ shieldtotal }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.


{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Surging Tides
abilities.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

abilities.name: Aqua Prison
abilities.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
abilities.tooltip: Nami hurls a bubble, <status>Stunning</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
abilities.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to {{ maxtargets }} targets.
  • Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.
  • Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion.
    The damage and healing value is modified by {{ bouncescaling }} each bounce. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
abilities.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
abilities.tooltip: Nami empowers an allied champion's next {{ hitcount }} Attacks and Abilities for {{ buffduration }} seconds, causing them to <status>Slow</status> their targets by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }}s and deal an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.
abilities.tooltip:
Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by {{ slowamount }}%, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to {{ maxslowduration }} seconds.

Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Soul Eater
abilities.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.

abilities.name: Siphoning Strike
abilities.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
abilities.tooltip: Nasus' next Attack deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by {{ basicstacks }}, increased to {{ bigstacks }} against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.description: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.
abilities.tooltip: Nasus ages a champion, <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowbase }}%, increasing to {{ maxslowtooltiponly }}% over {{ duration }} seconds. Their <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> is also reduced by {{ attackspeedslowmult*100 }}% of the <status>Slow</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spirit Fire
abilities.description: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.
abilities.tooltip: Nasus ignites a spirit flame, dealing <magicDamage>{{ initialdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies in the area lose <scaleArmor>{{ armorshredpercent*-100 }}% Armor</scaleArmor> and take <magicDamage>{{ totaldotdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fury of the Sands
abilities.description: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.
abilities.tooltip:
Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for 15 seconds, increasing his maximum Health by {{ bonushealth }} and Armor and Magic Resistance by {{ initialresistgain }}.

While the storm rages, nearby enemies take {{ damagecalc }} of their maximum Health as magic damage each second and Siphoning Strike has a {{ qcdr*100 }}% reduced Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Staggering Blow
