Mini Jack in the Boxes deal {{ aoedamage }} magic damage, or {{ stdamage }} magic damage if firing at only one enemy, and Fear for {{ boxfearduration }} second.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ki Barrier
abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

abilities.name: Twilight Assault
abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
abilities.tooltip:
Shen recalls his Spirit Blade. Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by {{ slowpercent }}% while moving away from Shen for the next {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Additionally, Shen's next {{ numenhancedattacks }} Attacks deal an additional {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ basepercenthealth }} max Health magic damage. If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade, the damage is increased to {{ baseflatdamage }} plus {{ emppercenthealth }} max Health magic damage and he gains {{ steroidas }}% Attack Speed for those Attacks.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spirit's Refuge
abilities.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
abilities.tooltip:
Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked.

If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to {{ zonedelay }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shadow Dash
abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers {{ energyrefund }} Energy.

Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for {{ ccduration }} seconds and dealing {{ tauntdamage }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Stand United
abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
abilities.tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between <shield>{{ shield }}</shield> and <shield>{{ maxshield }} Shield</shield> based on their missing Health for {{ shieldduration }} seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for {{ channelduration }} seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his <keywordMajor>Spirit Blade</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Scalemail
abilities.description: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

abilities.name: Emberstrike
abilities.description: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal {{ calc_max_health_damage }} max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ cooldown_reduction }} seconds.

Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing {{ calc_damage }} physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next {{ recastduration }} seconds.

Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing {{ calc_dragon_form_damage }} true damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Inferno Aegis
abilities.description: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates.  While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.
abilities.tooltip:
Shyvana wraps herself in flames for {{ duration }} seconds, gaining {{ calc_shield }} Shield, increased by {{ calc_shield_per_nearby_champion }} per nearby enemy champion and {{ movespeed }} Move Speed, increased to {{ movespeedtowardsenemies }} when moving towards enemy champions.

When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage.

Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for {{ calc_base_heal }} + {{ calc_missing_health_heal }} Missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Molten Burst
abilities.description: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.
abilities.tooltip:
Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing {{ damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_damage }} Max health magic damage and Slowing by {{ calc_slow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus.

Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals {{ calc_dragon_damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_dragon_damage }} Max Health magic damage and Slows by {{ calc_slow_dragon }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for {{ groundlingerduration }} seconds that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dragon's Descent
abilities.description: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana generates {{ fury_generation }} Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by {{ tt_fury_mult }} while in Dragon Form, and reduced {{ tt_fury_aoe_penalty }} by when striking in an area against non-champions.

Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and causing them Flee for {{ fearduration }} seconds.

While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains {{ calc_bonus_health }} bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Noxious Slipstream
abilities.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

abilities.name: Poison Trail
abilities.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
abilities.tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals <magicDamage>{{ damagepersecond }} magic damage</magicDamage> per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mega Adhesive
abilities.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.
abilities.tooltip: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, <status>Grounding</status> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies in the area by {{ slowpercent }}% for {{ wduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fling
abilities.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.
abilities.tooltip:
Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing {{ basedamage }} plus {{ maxhpdamage }}% max Health magic damage.

If Singed flings a target into his Mega Adhesive, they are Rooted for {{ rootduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Insanity Potion
abilities.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
abilities.tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him {{ statamount }} <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor>, <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, <speed>Move Speed</speed>, <healing>Health Regen</healing>, and <scaleMana>Mana Regen</scaleMana> for {{ duration }} seconds. During this effect, Singed's <spellName>Poison Trail</spellName> also applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for {{ grievousduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Glory in Death
abilities.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

abilities.name: Decimating Smash
abilities.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.
abilities.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Sion charges a heavy blow for up to 2 seconds.

Release: Sion slams his axe down, briefly Slowing and dealing between {{ mindamagetotal }} and {{ maxdamagetotal }} physical damage based on charge time. If Sion charged for at least 1 second, enemies are Knocked Up and Stunned for between {{ basestuntime }} and 2.25 seconds based on charge time.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Soul Furnace
abilities.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Sion gains {{ hpperkill }} max Health when he kills a unit, or {{ hpperchampkill }} for champion takedowns, large minions and large monsters.

Active: Sion gains {{ totalshield }} Shield for 6 seconds. After {{ detonaterecastcooldown }} seconds if the shield still holds, Sion can Recast to detonate the shield to deal {{ totaldamage }} plus {{ maxhpdamageratio }}% max Health magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Roar of the Slayer
abilities.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.
abilities.tooltip: Sion fires a shockwave, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds and removing <scaleArmor>{{ armorshred }}% Armor</scaleArmor> for {{ armorshredduration }} seconds. Non-champions hit are <status>Knocked Back</status>. Enemies hit by a <status>Knocked Back</status> unit take the same damage and effects.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
abilities.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.
abilities.tooltip:
Sion charges Unstoppably in a direction for 8 seconds, turning towards the mouse cursor. Sion stops on colliding with an enemy champion or wall or on Recasting this Ability.

At the end of the charge, Sion deals between {{ mindamagetotal }} and {{ maxdamagetotal }} physical damage based on distance travelled. Enemies close to Sion are Stunned for between {{ minstunduration }} and {{ maxstunduration }} seconds based on distance travelled. Enemies in a larger area are Slowed by {{ slowamount }}% for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fleet of Foot
abilities.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

abilities.name: Boomerang Blade
abilities.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
abilities.tooltip: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }}</physicalDamage> to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of {{ falloffminimum*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.description: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
abilities.tooltip:
For the next {{ buffduration }} seconds, Sivir gains {{ ricochetattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing {{ bouncedamage }} physical damage each bounce for up to {{ maxbounces }} bounces.

These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spell Shield
abilities.description: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.
abilities.tooltip: Sivir creates a magical barrier for {{ spellshieldduration }} seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores <healing>{{ totalheal }} health</healing> and triggers Fleet of Foot.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: On The Hunt
abilities.description: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.
abilities.tooltip:
Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them {{ maxms*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ ultduration }} seconds.

Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by {{ attackcooldownrefund }} seconds.

Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Threads of Vibration
abilities.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

abilities.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
abilities.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.
abilities.tooltip:
Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and dealing {{ abilitydamage }} physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional {{ maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s.

Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing {{ spell.skarnerq:abilitydamage }} + {{ spell.skarnerq:maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by {{ spell.skarnerq:slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ spell.skarnerq:slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Seismic Bastion
abilities.description: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.
abilities.tooltip: Skarner gains <shield>{{ initialshield }} Shield</shield> for {{ shieldduration }}s and triggers an earthquake that deals <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slows</status> nearby enemies by {{ sloweffect*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ixtal's Impact
abilities.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.
abilities.tooltip:
Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge.

Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals {{ pindamage }} physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for {{ stunduration }}s.

Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.
abilities.tooltip:
Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for {{ duration }}s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability.

If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains {{ speedboostamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ speedboostduration }} seconds.

If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dragon Practice
abilities.description: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

abilities.name: Super Scorcher Breath
abilities.description: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.
abilities.tooltip:
Smolder belches flame, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_qdamageincrease }} magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds {{ manarestore }} Mana, once per cast.

Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:
  • {{ stacktier1 }} Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.
  • {{ stacktier2 }} Stacks: Sends {{ tier2_numberofblowback }} explosions beyond the target that deal {{ tier2_blowbackpercentagedamage }}% of this Ability's damage.
  • {{ stacktier3 }} Stacks: Burns the target, dealing {{ tier3_burn }} max Health true damage over {{ tier3_dotlength }} seconds. Enemy champions that drop below {{ tier3_executethreshold }} total health while burning are killed instantly.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Achooo!
abilities.description: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip:
Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing {{ initialdamage }} physical damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing {{ explosiondamage }} physical + {{ spell.smolderp:passive_wdamageincrease }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
abilities.description: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.
abilities.tooltip:
Smolder takes flight, gaining {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for {{ duration }} seconds.

While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy {{ totalnumberofattacks }} (rounded down) times for {{ damageperhit }} physical damage + {{ spell.smolderp:ebonusdamage }} magic damage per hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: MMOOOMMMM!
abilities.description: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
abilities.tooltip:
Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage. Enemies in the center take {{ tooltiponly_totalsweetspotdamage }} physical damage instead and are Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Smolder's mom heals her son for {{ momhealcalc }} Health if she hits him.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Power Chord
abilities.description:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

abilities.name: Hymn of Valor
abilities.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Sona deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody. Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds, granting allied champions an additional {{ totalonhitdamage }} magic damage %i:OnHit% on their next Attack within {{ onhitduration }} seconds.

Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage ({{ totalstaccatodamage }} total magic damage).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Aria of Perseverance
abilities.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.
abilities.tooltip:
Active: Sona restores {{ totalheal }} Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds, granting allied champions {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.

Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least {{ accelerandoshieldbreakpoint }} damage with this shield.

Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by {{ totaldiminuendoweakenpercent }} for {{ diminuendoduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Song of Celerity
abilities.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.
abilities.tooltip:
Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself {{ totalselfmovementspeed }} Move Speed for {{ selfmovementspeeddurationmin }} seconds, extended to up to {{ selfmovementspeeddurationmax }} seconds if she doesn't take damage.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for {{ auraduration }} seconds that grants allied champions {{ totalallymovementspeed }} Move Speed for {{ allymovementspeedduration }} seconds.

Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by {{ totaltempomovespeedslow }} for {{ tempoduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Crescendo
abilities.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.
abilities.tooltip: Sona strikes an irresistible chord, <status>Stunning</status> enemy for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Salvation
abilities.description: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

abilities.name: Starcall
abilities.description: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.
abilities.tooltip:
Soraka calls down a star, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ movespeedslow*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores {{ totalhot }} Health over {{ hotduration }} seconds and grants {{ movespeedhaste*100 }}% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Astral Infusion
abilities.description: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.
abilities.tooltip:
Soraka restores {{ totalheal }} Health to another allied champion.

If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by {{ percenthealthcostrefund*100 }}%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for {{ spell.sorakaq:hotduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Equinox
abilities.description: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.
abilities.tooltip: Soraka creates a starfield that deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to champions. The field lingers for {{ rootdelay }} seconds, <status>Silencing</status> enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are <status>Rooted</status> for {{ rootduration }} second(s) and take <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wish
abilities.description: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.
abilities.tooltip: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring <healing>{{ healingcalc }} Health</healing> to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to <healing>{{ ampedhealing }}</healing> on targets below 40% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Ravenous Flock
abilities.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

abilities.name: Death's Hand
abilities.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.
abilities.tooltip: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing <magicDamage>{{ initialdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> plus <magicDamage>{{ extraboltdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> per bolt past the first (max <magicDamage>{{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Vision of Empire
abilities.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
abilities.tooltip:
Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slow*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for {{ revealduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Nevermove
abilities.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
abilities.tooltip:
Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage and Root enemies in the area for {{ rootduration }} seconds.

Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
abilities.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip:
Swain frees the demon, which deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and drains {{ healingcalc }} Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns.

After {{ demonflarecastdelay }} seconds and every {{ demonflarecooldowntooltip }} seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals {{ demonflaredamagetotal }} magic damage and Slows enemies by {{ demonflareslowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ demonflareslowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Petricite Burst
abilities.description: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

abilities.name: Chain Lash
abilities.description:
Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies.

After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.
abilities.tooltip: Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowamountcalc }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further <magicDamage>{{ explosiondamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Kingslayer
abilities.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.
abilities.tooltip: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing <magicDamage>{{ mindamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Against champions, Sylas restores between <healing>{{ minhealing }}</healing> and <healing>{{ maxhealing }} Health</healing> based on his missing Health (max healing at or below {{ maxexecutethreshold*100 }}% Health).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Abscond / Abduct
abilities.description: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.
abilities.tooltip:
Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds.

Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage, and Knocking Up for {{ knockupduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hijack
abilities.description: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.
abilities.tooltip:
Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate Ability, based on his Ultimate level and using his stats.

Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for {{ pertargetcooldown }}% (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of {{ minimumenemycooldown }} seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Transcendent
abilities.description:
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.

Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge
Force of Will: Bonus true damage.
Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets
Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets

abilities.name: Dark Sphere
abilities.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.
abilities.tooltip:
Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. The Dark Sphere remains for {{ sphereduration }} seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities.

{{ spell.syndrapassive:q1upgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath: Syndra can store {{ upgrade1maxammo }} charges of Dark Sphere.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Force of Will
abilities.description: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Syndra grabs a Dark Sphere, enemy minion, or non-epic monster. She drags it with her and can Recast for up to 5 seconds.

Recast: Syndra hurls the object, dealing {{ throwdamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ totalslowamount }}% for {{ f2 }} seconds.

{{ spell.syndrapassive:wupgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath: This Ability deals an additional {{ tooltiponlypassivebonuspercent }} true damage.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Scatter the Weak
abilities.description: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.
abilities.tooltip:
Syndra projects a wave of force, Knocking Back enemies and Dark Spheres and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Dark Spheres that are pushed Stun enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds and deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

{{ spell.syndrapassive:eupgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath: This Ability's width is increased and Slows enemies by {{ upgradedslowamount*100 }}% for {{ upgradedslowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unleashed Power
abilities.description: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Dark Sphere gains an additional {{ qhasteperrank }} Ability Haste for each rank of Unleashed Power.

Syndra draws on her full cataclysmic power, launching the 3 Dark Spheres orbiting her plus up to 4 more nearby at an enemy champion. Each Dark Sphere deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage (max {{ maxdamagecalc }} magic damage).

{{ spell.syndrapassive:rupgradethreshold }} Splinters of Wrath: This Ability executes enemies below {{ upgradeexecutethreshold*100 }}% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: An Acquired Taste
abilities.description: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of <spellName>An Acquired Taste</spellName>. At three stacks, he can use <spellName>Devour</spellName> on an enemy champion.

abilities.name: Tongue Lash
abilities.description:
Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.

Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.
abilities.tooltip:
Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

On champion hit, heals Tahm for {{ baseheal }} +{{ percenthealthhealing*100 }}% of his missing Health and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste dealing {{ spell.tahmkenchpassive:totaldamage }} extra magic damage. If that champion already had 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they will also be Stunned for {{ stunduration }} seconds, consuming the stacks.

Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from a distance when you hit them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Abyssal Dive
abilities.description: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.
abilities.tooltip:
Dive down and then re-appear at target location, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Knock Up all enemies in an area for {{ knockupduration }} second. Hitting at least one enemy champion refunds {{ champrefund*100 }}% of the Cooldown and Mana cost.

Devoured allies can be taken along for the ride (but can always hop out early).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Thick Skin
abilities.description:
Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat.

Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: {{ greyhealthratio*100 }}% of damage Tahm Kench takes is stored by his Thick Skin, increased to {{ greyhealthratioenhanced*100 }}% if there are at least {{ enhancedthreshold }} nearby enemy champions. If Kench has not taken damage within {{ ooctimer }} seconds, Thick Skin will rapidly be consumed to heal Tahm for {{ greyhealthhealingratio }} of its value.

Active: Convert all your stored Thick Skin into a Shield, lasting {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.
abilities.tooltip:
Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out.

Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste. Are devoured for up to {{ enemyduration }} seconds and take {{ basedamage }} (+{{ percenthpdamage }} of their Max Health) magic damage. Tahm Kench is Slowed by {{ slowamount*100 }}% and Grounded during this effect.

Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to {{ allyduration }} seconds and are granted {{ totalshield }} Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast Abyssal Dive and gains {{ allyspeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ allyduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Rock Surfing
abilities.description: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

abilities.name: Threaded Volley
abilities.description: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Taliyah hurls 5 rocks, each dealing {{ rockdamage }} magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit while creating Worked Ground at that area. Subsequent hits against the same enemy deal {{ extramissilereduceddamagepercent }}% less damage.

Casts on worked ground cost {{ bigrockmanacost }} Mana and have {{ workedgroundcdr*100 }}% less Cooldown, consume the Worked Ground, and hurl a boulder that Slows enemies it hits by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds, dealing {{ bigrockdamage }} magic damage to the primary target. Monsters hit by the boulder are Stunned for {{ monsterstunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Seismic Shove
abilities.description: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.
abilities.tooltip: Taliyah quakes the earth, <status>Knocking</status> enemies in an area in the chosen direction.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Unraveled Earth
abilities.description: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.
abilities.tooltip: Taliyah scatters loose stones in an area, <status>Slowing</status> enemies hit by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% and dealing <magicDamage>{{ scatterdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. The stones detonate when enemies dash or are <status>Knocked</status> through them, <status>Stunning</status> for the remaining movement duration + {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ detonationdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Weaver's Wall
abilities.description: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.
abilities.tooltip:
Taliyah creates a massive earthen wall for {{ wallduration }} seconds. If she immediately Recasts, she will ride along the wall as it unravels. Moving or being immobilized will end the ride.

This ability cannot be cast if Taliyah has taken damage from Champions or structures within the last {{ damagelockouttime }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blade's End
abilities.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

abilities.name: Noxian Diplomacy
abilities.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.
abilities.tooltip:
Talon leaps to a target and deals {{ leapdamage }} physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for {{ criticaldamage }} physical damage.

If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores {{ totalhealing }} Health and refunds {{ cooldownrefund*100 }}% of its Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.
abilities.tooltip: Talon tosses a volley of blades, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totalinitialdamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. The blades then return to him, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totalreturndamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ movespeedslow*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Assassin's Path
abilities.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.
abilities.tooltip: Talon vaults over the nearest terrain or structure. Talon cannot dash over the same terrain more than once every {{ wallcd }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shadow Assault
abilities.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.
abilities.tooltip:
Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal {{ damage }} physical damage, gains {{ movespeed*100 }}% Move Speed, and becomes Invisible for {{ duration }} seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage again.

If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with Noxian Diplomacy, the blades return to the target instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bravado
abilities.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

abilities.name: Starlight's Touch
abilities.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Gain a stack (max {{ maxcharges }}) every {{ stackcooldown }} seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack.

Active: Consume all stacks to restore {{ healingperstack }} Health per stack to nearby ally champions ({{ maxstackhealing }} at {{ maxcharges }} stacks).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bastion
abilities.description:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Taric gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally.

Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a {{ shieldhpratio }}% max Health Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dazzle
abilities.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
abilities.tooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after {{ chargeduration }} second to deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stun</status> enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Cosmic Radiance
abilities.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
abilities.tooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After {{ initialdelay }} seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for {{ invulnduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Guerrilla Warfare
abilities.description: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Blinding Dart
abilities.description: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.
abilities.tooltip: Teemo fires a dart, <status>Blinding</status> the target for {{ blindduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ calculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Move Quick
abilities.description: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Teemo gains {{ passivemovespeedbonus*100 }}% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last {{ passivecooldownondamagetaken }} seconds.

Active: Teemo sprints, gaining {{ activemovespeedbonus*100 }}% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for {{ activemovespeedbuffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Toxic Shot
abilities.description: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.
abilities.tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Teemo's Attacks apply poison %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing an additional <magicDamage>{{ impactcalculateddamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> plus <magicDamage>{{ totaldotdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over {{ poisonduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Noxious Trap
abilities.description: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.
abilities.tooltip:
Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by {{ slowamount }}% and deal {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over {{ debuffduration }} seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration.

Traps last {{ mushroomduration }} minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has {{ maxammo }} charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Damnation
abilities.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

abilities.name: Death Sentence
abilities.description: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.
abilities.tooltip:
Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for {{ tauntlength }} seconds. The scythe does {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration.

Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy.

If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by {{ hitbonuscooldown }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dark Passage
abilities.description: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.
abilities.tooltip:
Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh.

The lantern also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Flay
abilities.description: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between {{ pattackdamagemin }} and {{ pattackdamagemax }} magic damage.

Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by {{ activeslowpercentage }}% for {{ slowduration }} second and take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: The Box
abilities.description: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
abilities.tooltip: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, <status>Slowing</status> champions by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and <status>Slow</status> for half duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Draw a Bead
abilities.description: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.
abilities.tooltip: Tristana goes full-auto, gaining <attackSpeed>{{ attackspeedmod*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for {{ buffduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Rocket Jump
abilities.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.
abilities.tooltip:
Tristana launches herself, dealing {{ landingdamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowmod*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds upon landing.

Champion takedowns and max stack Explosive Charge detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Explosive Charge
abilities.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Tristana's Attacks that kill enemies deal {{ passivedamage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Active: Tristana attaches a bomb to an enemy or turret that deals {{ activedamage }} physical damage to surrounding enemies after {{ activeduration }} seconds. The damage is increased by {{ activeperstackamp*100 }}% each time Tristana hits an Attack or Ability (max 4 stacks).

At {{ activemaxstacks }} stacks, the bomb explodes immediately (max {{ activemaxdamage }} physical damage).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Buster Shot
abilities.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.
abilities.tooltip: Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing <magicDamage>{{ damagecalc }} magic damage</magicDamage> to the target, <status>Knocking Back</status> and <status>Stunning</status> them and surrounding enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: King's Tribute
abilities.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

abilities.name: Chomp
abilities.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.
abilities.tooltip: Trundle's next Attack deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and briefly <status>Slows</status> by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, then Trundle gains <physicalDamage>{{ bonusad }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for {{ sapdebuffduration }} seconds and the enemy loses <physicalDamage>{{ sappedad*-1 }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for the same duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Frozen Domain
abilities.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.
abilities.tooltip: Trundle freezes an area for {{ duration }} seconds. While inside he gains <speed>{{ msbonus*100 }}% Move Speed</speed>, <attackSpeed>{{ asbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, and {{ healingbonus*100 }}% increased healing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Pillar of Ice
abilities.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.
abilities.tooltip: Trundle creates an icy pillar for {{ pillarduration }} seconds, briefly <status>Knocking Back</status> enemies directly over it and <status>Slowing</status> nearby enemies by {{ slowamount }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Subjugate
abilities.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.
abilities.tooltip: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totalpercenthpdamage }} max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and stealing <scaleArmor>{{ armormrshred*100 }}% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> over {{ actualdurationofdrainbuff }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to {{ maximumbonusad }} Attack Damage based on his missing Health.

Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring {{ baseheal }} plus {{ healperfury }} Health per Fury (max: {{ maximumheal }}). {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Mocking Shout
abilities.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.
abilities.tooltip: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by {{ adreduction*-1 }} for {{ reductionduration }} seconds and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowpotency*-100 }}% while cowering from him for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spinning Slash
abilities.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
abilities.tooltip:
Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and generating {{ nonchampfurygain }} Fury per enemy hit, increased to {{ champfurygain }} Fury against enemy champions.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ nonchampcdrefund }} seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by {{ champcdrefund }} seconds when critically striking a champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Undying Rage
abilities.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
abilities.tooltip: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for {{ tryndrduration }} seconds, refusing to be reduced below {{ tryndrminhealth }} Health, and instantly gains <keywordMajor>{{ tryndrfurygain }} Fury</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Loaded Dice
abilities.description: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

abilities.name: Wild Cards
abilities.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.
abilities.tooltip: Twisted Fate throws three cards that deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Pick a Card
abilities.description: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.
abilities.tooltip:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.
  • The Blue Card deals {{ bluedamage }} magic damage and restores {{ e6 }} Mana.
  • The Red Card deals {{ reddamage }} to nearby enemies and Slows by {{ e2 }}% for 2.5 seconds.
  • The Gold Card deals {{ golddamage }} and Stuns for {{ e3 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Stacked Deck
abilities.description: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.
abilities.tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Twisted Fate gains <attackSpeed>{{ attackspeedbonus }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and every 4th Attack deals an additional <magicDamage>{{ bonusdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Destiny
abilities.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.
abilities.tooltip:
Twisted Fate focuses on his cards, granting True Sight of all enemy champions on the map for {{ e1 }} seconds and allowing him to Recast.

Recast: Twisted Fate teleports up to {{ e4 }} units away.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Deadly Venom
abilities.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing true damage each second.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description:
Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.

When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.
abilities.tooltip:
Twitch Camouflages and gains {{ movespeedmod }}% Move Speed for {{ stealthduration }} seconds. The Move Speed increases to {{ hiddenspeed }}% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains {{ attackspeedmod*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds.

When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Venom Cask
abilities.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
abilities.tooltip:
Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for {{ duration }} seconds.

Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by {{ totalslowamount }}% and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Contaminate
abilities.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
abilities.tooltip:
Deals {{ basedamage }} physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional {{ physicaldamageperstack }} physical damage and {{ magicdamageperstack }} magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom.

Max Damage: {{ maxphysicaldamage }} physical damage and {{ maxmagicdamage }} magical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Spray and Pray
abilities.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
abilities.tooltip:
Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining {{ bonusrange }} Attack Range and {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for {{ duration }} seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal {{ falloffdamage*100 }}% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of {{ minimumfalloffdamage*100 }}% damage.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Bridge Between
abilities.description: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Wilding Claw
abilities.description: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.
abilities.tooltip:
Claw Stance: Udyr gains {{ attackspeedbase*100 }}% Attack Speed and his Attacks deal {{ onhitdamage }} physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit for {{ attackspeeddurationbase }} seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal a bonus {{ maxhponhit1 }} max Health physical damage and gain {{ attackrange }} range.

Awaken: Increase bonus Attack Speed to {{ empoweredtotalas }} and max Health damage to {{ q2totalonhithpdamage }}. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks call lightning six times, dealing a total of {{ empoweredlightningbonusmax }} max Health magic damage to isolated targets (strikes bounce to other nearby targets when possible).
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Iron Mantle
abilities.description: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.
abilities.tooltip:
Mantle Stance: Udyr gains {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks gain {{ lifesteal*100 }}% Life Steal and restore {{ lifeonhit }} Health.

Awaken: Gain {{ recastshield }} Shield, restore {{ recastheal }} Health over {{ shieldduration }} seconds, and Udyr's next two Attacks instead have {{ lifesteal*200 }}% Life Steal and restore {{ lifeonhitawakened }} Health.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blazing Stampede
abilities.description: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.
abilities.tooltip:
Stampede Stance: Udyr gains {{ movespeed }} Move Speed, decaying over {{ movespeedduration }} seconds. Additionally, Udyr's Attacks dash him to the target and Stun for {{ stunduration }} seconds ({{ icd }} second Cooldown per target).

Awaken: Grants immunity to Immobilizing and Disabling effects and an additional {{ movespeedbonus }} Move Speed for {{ unstoppableduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Wingborne Storm
abilities.description: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Storm Stance: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm for {{ buffduration }} seconds, dealing {{ stormdamage }} magic damage per second to nearby enemies and Slowing them by {{ slowpotency*100 }}%. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal {{ pulsedamage }} magic damage to enemies in the storm.

Awaken: Unleash the storm, causing it to follow Udyr's last Attacked enemy, deal an additional {{ percenthpblast }} max Health magic damage over the duration, and Slow by an additional {{ empoweredslow }}.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Echoing Flames
abilities.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

abilities.name: Corrosive Charge
abilities.description: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.
abilities.tooltip: Urgot fires an explosive charge, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.description: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Urgot's other Abilities mark the last champion hit for 5 seconds.

Active: Urgot begins firing his chain gun at the closest enemy, prioritizing marked enemies. He Attacks them {{ wattackspersecond }} times a second dealing {{ damagepershot }} physical damage per shot. Urgot can move while firing and has {{ slowresistance }}% Slow resistance, but loses {{ movespeedmod }} Move Speed.

At max rank, this Ability lasts indefinitely and can be Toggled on and off.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Disdain
abilities.description: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.
abilities.tooltip: Urgot charges forward, gaining <shield>{{ etotalshieldhealth }} Shield</shield> for {{ eshieldduration }} seconds. The first champion hit is <status>Stunned</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and thrown behind Urgot. All enemies Urgot collides with take <physicalDamage>{{ edamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Fear Beyond Death
abilities.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.
abilities.tooltip:
Urgot fires a chem-drill, impaling the first champion hit, dealing {{ rcalculateddamage }} physical damage and Slowing for {{ rslowduration }} seconds by 1% per 1% missing Health, up to {{ rmovespeedmod }}%.

If the impaled victim falls below {{ rhealththreshold }}% Health, Urgot can Recast this Ability, Suppressing the victim and dragging them to himself. On reaching Urgot, they are killed and nearby enemies are Feared for {{ rfearduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Living Vengeance
abilities.description: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
abilities.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.
abilities.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by {{ movespeedmod*-100 }}%. After {{ maxchannelduration }} seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund {{ manarefund*100 }}% of its Mana cost.

Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing {{ totaldamagemin }} physical damage, reduced by {{ falloffpercent*100 }}% per enemy hit (minimum {{ mindamagepercent*100 }}%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to {{ maxchannelamp*100 }}% based on charge time (up to to {{ totaldamagemax }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
abilities.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.
abilities.tooltip:
Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage and apply a Blight stack for {{ debuffduration }} seconds (max {{ maxstacks }} stacks).

Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing {{ percenthpperstack }} max Health magic damage per stack (max {{ maxpercenthpperstack }} max Health damage). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by {{ cdrperblightstack*100 }}% of their Maximum per stack.

Active: Varus' next Piercing Arrow deals an additional {{ qempowerpercenthp }} missing Health magic damage, increased up to {{ maxqempowerpercenthp }} missing Health damage based on charge time.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
abilities.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.
abilities.tooltip: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and desecrates the ground for {{ groundduration }} seconds, <status>Slowing</status> enemies by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% and applying {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
abilities.description: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.
abilities.tooltip:
Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for {{ rootduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. Rooted enemies gain {{ passivestacks }} Blight stacks over the duration.

The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Night Hunter
abilities.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

abilities.name: Tumble
abilities.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional {{ adratiobonus }} physical damage on her next Attack.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Silver Bolts
abilities.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.
abilities.tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive</spellPassive>: Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional <trueDamage>{{ totaldamage }} max Health true damage</trueDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.
abilities.tooltip: Vayne fires a bolt that <status>Knocks Back</status> and deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage>. If the target collides with terrain, they take <physicalDamage>{{ empowereddamagett }} bonus physical damage</physicalDamage> and become <status>Stunned</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Final Hour
abilities.description: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter
abilities.tooltip: Vayne gains <physicalDamage>{{ bonusattackdamage }} Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for {{ baseduration }} seconds, extended by {{ durationtoadd }} seconds whenever a champion damaged by Vayne dies within {{ damagedmarkerduration }} seconds. Additionally, during the duration:<li><spellName>Night Hunter</spellName> instead grants <speed>{{ movementspeed }} Move Speed</speed>.<li>The Cooldown of <spellName>Tumble</spellName> is reduced by {{ tumblecdreduction }}%, and grants <keywordStealth>Invisibility</keywordStealth> for {{ tumblestealthduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
abilities.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

abilities.name: Baleful Strike
abilities.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
abilities.tooltip:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstacks }} stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant {{ spell.veigarpassive:dqkillstackslarge }} stacks instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Dark Matter
abilities.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
abilities.tooltip:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

Every {{ spell.veigarpassive:pstacksperdarkmattercdr }} stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ spell.veigarpassive:darkmattercdrincrement*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
abilities.tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that <status>Stuns</status> enemies that pass through for {{ stunduration }} seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Primordial Burst
abilities.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
abilities.tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between <magicDamage>{{ mindamage }} and {{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Organic Deconstruction
abilities.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply <keywordName>Organic Deconstruction</keywordName> to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

abilities.name: Plasma Fission
abilities.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.
abilities.tooltip:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% decaying over {{ slowduration }} second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores {{ tooltipmanarefund }} Mana.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Void Rift
abilities.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.
abilities.tooltip:
Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing {{ initialdamage }} magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing {{ secondarydamage }} magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Tectonic Disruption
abilities.description: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.
abilities.tooltip: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, <status>Knocking Up</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be <status>Knocked Back</status> instead of <status>Knocked Up</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
abilities.description: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.
abilities.tooltip:
Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of {{ totaldamage }} magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by {{ e3 }}%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Doom 'n Gloom
abilities.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

abilities.name: Mistral Bolt
abilities.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.
abilities.tooltip:
Vex launches a wave of mist that deals {{ qdamagecalc }} magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Personal Space
abilities.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Vex gains {{ shieldcalc }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds and emits a shockwave that deals {{ wdamagecalc }} magic damage.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Looming Darkness
abilities.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.
abilities.tooltip:
Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals {{ edamagecalc }} magic damage and Slows by {{ slowamount*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds.

Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by {{ gloomcdnonchamptooltip*100 }}%.

Applies Gloom to enemies hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Shadow Surge
abilities.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.
abilities.tooltip:
Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing {{ spell.vexr:rdamagecalc }} magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds.

Recast: Dash to the marked champion, dealing {{ spell.vexr:recastdamagecalc }} magic damage on arrival.

If the marked champion dies within {{ spell.vexr:takedownwindow }} seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Blast Shield
abilities.description: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

abilities.name: Vault Breaker
abilities.description: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.
abilities.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by {{ selfslow }}%.

Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between {{ totaldamage }} and {{ maxdamagetooltip }} physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

abilities.name: Denting Blows
abilities.description: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.
